"use client"; // React & Next.js // Third-party libraries // Page-specific components , []); // Helper for safe scrolling const scrollToId = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => { e.preventDefault(); const element = document.getElementById(id); if (element) { const yOffset = -100; const y = element.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset + yOffset; window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'smooth' }); } }; return ( {/* Breadcrumbs */} Home Documentation {currentSlug.split('/').pop()?.replace('-', ' ')} {/* Content */} Chauffeur Architecture Understanding the core design principles and architecture of Chauffeur. Core Principles scrollToId(e, 'core-principles')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur is built upon a set of core principles that prioritize workspace isolation, minimal host impact, and developer ergonomics. Workspace-first: All binaries, configs, sockets, and logs live under ~/.chauffeur . Minimal host impact: Prefer workspace changes. Host-level changes (e.g., dnsmasq configs) are avoided or require explicit user action. Manual project registration: Projects are registered explicitly using chauf link . Idempotent operations: Commands like init , install , link are safe to re-run. Linux-focused: Designed for Arch/Ubuntu/Debian, no macOS/Windows assumptions. No external env managers: Chauffeur ships its own runtimes. Documentation parity: README.md, docs/TODO_STATUS.md, and AGENTS.md must be kept in sync with the codebase. Host edits only as last resort: System modifications are opt-in and include cleanup guidance. Workspace Layout & Config Contracts scrollToId(e, 'workspace-layout')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># All Chauffeur managed files and configurations reside within the ~/.chauffeur/ directory. /

 logs/
 php/ / # installed runtimes
 nginx/
 bin/
 etc/
 sites-available/
 sites-enabled/
 conf.d/
 certs/
 bin/
 chauf # optional self-managed binary
 shims/ # php, composer, php- 
 cli/templates/nginx/}/> chauffeur.yaml (Global Config) project.yaml (Per-Project State) /runtime/php-fpm/php-fpm.sock
created_at: 2025-10-30T12:00:00+07:00}/> PHP-FPM Architecture scrollToId(e, 'php-fpm-architecture')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur offers flexible PHP-FPM control, balancing resource efficiency with isolation needs. Shared FPM (Default) Resource efficient: Multiple projects share the same PHP-FPM pool per PHP version. Default behavior: chauf link uses shared FPM unless --dedicated-fpm is specified. Socket path example: ~/.chauffeur/php/8.3/runtime/php-fpm/php-fpm.sock Dedicated FPM (Optional) Maximum isolation: Each project gets its own PHP-FPM pool. Usage: chauf link --dedicated-fpm for critical projects. Socket path example: ~/.chauffeur/projects/<slug>/runtime/php-fpm/php-fpm.sock Chauffeur supports a mixed strategy, automatically routing Nginx to the correct socket based on project configuration. Multi-Domain Architecture scrollToId(e, 'multi-domain-architecture')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur supports multiple domains per project, featuring isolated SSL certificate management and alias-specific configuration. SSL Certificate Management Multi-domain SAN certificates cover all SSL-enabled domains. Supports mkcert (trusted) and self-signed certificates. Certificates are automatically regenerated upon alias changes. File naming uses the base domain (e.g., hja-cms.test.crt ). Domain Resolution Primary domain from proj.Site.Domain . Alias domains from proj.Domains.Aliases array. Helper methods provide GetAllDomains() , GetServerNames() , HasSSLEnabled() for Nginx integration. Nginx Architecture scrollToId(e, 'nginx-architecture')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur manages its own Nginx installation with optimized configurations for local development. Self-Contained Nginx Workspace isolation: Nginx binary and configurations reside under ~/.chauffeur/nginx/ Non-conflicting service: Runs as chauf-nginx to avoid conflicts with system nginx Port forwarding: Default ports 8080 (HTTP) and 8443 (HTTPS) with optional system port forwarding Template-based configs: Nginx configurations generated from templates for each project Configuration Management sites-available/: Template configurations for each linked project sites-enabled/: Active configurations (symlinks to sites-available) Dynamic generation: Configurations auto-generated from project state SSL integration: Automatic SSL certificate configuration and reload Port Management 🌐 Nginx Benefits • Zero system impact: Won't interfere with existing web servers • Consistent environment: Same Nginx version and modules across projects • Easy configuration: Optimized templates for common frameworks • SSL handling: Automatic certificate management and HTTPS redirection Composer Architecture scrollToId(e, 'composer-architecture')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur provides Composer with intelligent PHP version isolation and workspace integration. Version-Isolated Composer Project-aware Composer: Automatically uses the project's configured PHP version Global availability: Composer command available system-wide via PATH shims Version switching: Composer respects per-project PHP version settings Workspace isolation: Composer installation and cache managed within workspace PHP Version Integration Cache and Configuration Workspace cache: Composer cache isolated under ~/.chauffeur/composer/ Global packages: Composer global packages managed with workspace PHP version Authentication: Composer authentication tokens stored in workspace config Performance: Intelligent caching across projects with same PHP version Shims and PATH Integration 🎼 Composer Advantages • No PHP conflicts: Each project uses correct PHP version automatically • Dependency isolation: Composer cache isolated from system PHP • Seamless workflow: Standard Composer commands work as expected • Global packages: Composer global available with workspace isolation Service Management & Lifecycle scrollToId(e, 'service-management')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Chauffeur manages services with systemd-style naming and comprehensive lifecycle operations. Service Naming Convention Service Operations Start services: chauf start launches required services for all projects Stop services: chauf stop gracefully shuts down services Restart services: chauf restart stops and starts services Service status: chauf status shows running state and configuration Log access: chauf logs provides access to service logs System Integration Optional systemd: Services can be registered with systemd for auto-start Port forwarding: iptables rules for privileged port access (80/443) DNS integration: Optional dnsmasq configuration for .test domains SSL certificates: Integration with system trust stores for mkcert ⚙️ Service Design Philosophy • Non-intrusive: Services don't conflict with system packages • Self-contained: All dependencies managed within workspace • Portable: Workspace can be moved between systems • Observable: Comprehensive logging and status monitoring {/* Page Footer Navigation */} Previous First Project Next Command Reference {/* Right TOC (Desktop Only) */} ); }

Usage Flags Flag Description Default --php Specify PHP version (e.g. 8.1, 8.3) global --secure Generate SSL certificate for the site false --site Set custom domain (e.g. myapp.test) directory-name --alias Add domain alias (can be used multiple times) none --force Overwrite existing project configuration false --dedicated-fpm Use dedicated PHP-FPM pool for this project false --http-port Set custom HTTP port (1-65535) 80 --https-port Set custom HTTPS port (1-65535) 443 Example 🔐 SSL Certificate Requirements Self-signed certificates: Generated automatically without sudo privileges. Works locally but browsers show security warnings. Trusted certificates (mkcert): Requires sudo for system trust store installation. Provides browser-trusted certificates without security warnings. # Install mkcert for trusted certificates (requires sudo) go install -r filippo.io/mkcert@latest mkcert -install # Prompts for sudo password chauf isolate scrollToId(e, 'isolate')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Isolates the current site to a specific PHP version, separate from the global default. " /> Arguments Argument Description <version> PHP version to isolate to (e.g. 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3) Example chauf unlink scrollToId(e, 'unlink')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Remove registrations or specific aliases. Defaults to current dir. Flags Flag Description --slug Remove project by slug identifier --site Remove site configuration only --project Remove entire project configuration --alias Remove specific domain alias --all Remove all registered projects --force Skip confirmation prompts Example chauf status scrollToId(e, 'status')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Show status for global or per-project services. Arguments & Flags Flag Description [service-type] Filter by service type (nginx, php-fpm, dnsmasq) --project Show status for specific project only --detail Show detailed status information -v, --verbose Verbose output with additional details Example {/* Service Control Commands */} Service Control Commands for starting, stopping, and managing Chauffeur services. chauf start scrollToId(e, 'start')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Start nginx/PHP-FPM plus dnsmasq validation. ] [--all] [--dry-run]" /> Flags Flag Description --project Start specific project services --all Start all registered projects --dry-run Show what would be started Example chauf stop scrollToId(e, 'stop')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Stop services and clean port-forward rules. ] [--all] [--dry-run]" /> Example chauf restart scrollToId(e, 'restart')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Restart services (equivalent to stop then start, preserves configuration). ] [--all] [--dry-run]" /> Example {/* PHP Management Commands */} PHP Management Commands for managing PHP versions and installations. chauf php use scrollToId(e, 'php-use')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Set the global default PHP version for new sites. " /> Arguments Argument Description <version> PHP version to set as global default (e.g. 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3) Arguments Argument Description <version> PHP version to set as global default (e.g. 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4) Example chauf php isolate scrollToId(e, 'php-isolate')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Pin the current project to a specific PHP version. " /> Arguments Argument Description <version> PHP version to pin to current project (e.g. 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3, 8.4) Example chauf php list scrollToId(e, 'php-list')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># List all supported PHP versions and their installation status. Example chauf init scrollToId(e, 'init')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Initialize Chauffeur workspace with default configuration and directory structure. Flags Flag Description --force Overwrite existing configuration files --quiet, -q Suppress verbose output What It Creates {~/.chauffeur/ ├── config/chauffeur.yaml # Main configuration file ├── projects/ # Project storage ├── logs/ # Service logs ├── cache/ # Download cache ├── php/ # PHP installations ├── nginx/ # nginx configurations └── bin/ # Chauffeur binaries and shims} Examples chauf install scrollToId(e, 'install')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Install Chauffeur-managed services (nginx, php, composer). [version]" /> Services Service Description Example nginx Web server with Chauffeur configuration chauf install nginx php PHP runtime with development extensions chauf install php 8.3 composer PHP dependency manager with version isolation chauf install composer Flags Flag Description Default --force Reinstall even if already present false --local Use local PHP tarball (PHP only) false --no-cache Skip download caching false Examples 💡 Installation Order Recommended installation sequence: 1) nginx → 2) php → 3) composer. Nginx provides the web server, PHP adds runtime support, and composer manages dependencies. chauf php install scrollToId(e, 'php-install')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Build/install PHP runtime under workspace. [--force] [--no-ext] [--from ]" /> Arguments & Flags Argument/Flag Description Default <version> PHP version to install (e.g. 7.4, 8.0, 8.1, 8.2, 8.3) - --force Reinstall even if already exists false --no-ext Skip extension compilation (faster install) false --from <source> Install from specific source (package, source) package Example {/* Utility Commands */} Utilities Utility commands for debugging, maintenance, and system management. chauf logs scrollToId(e, 'logs')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># View and follow service logs with interactive version selection. Arguments & Flags Argument/Flag Description Default [service] Service to monitor (nginx, php-fpm, dnsmasq, or all) all [version] PHP version (8.1, 8.2, 8.3) for PHP-FPM logs all --follow, -f Follow logs in real-time (like tail -f) false --lines, -n Number of lines to show from end 50 --level Filter by log level (error, warn, info, debug) all --context, -c Show context lines around matches 3 Example chauf clean scrollToId(e, 'clean')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Clean workspace files with file size display and accurate reporting. Arguments & Flags Argument/Flag Description Default [target] What to clean (logs, cache, temp, certs, all) all --dry-run Show what would be deleted without actually deleting false --force Skip confirmation prompts false --older-than Delete files older than specified duration (e.g. 7d, 30d) 0d (all) --keep-versions Keep N most recent versions of each file 3 --what Detailed breakdown of what would be cleaned false Example chauf doctor scrollToId(e, 'doctor')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Perform health checks and diagnose system issues. Flags Flag Description --check-all, -a Run all dependency checks (default) --check-deps, -d Check system dependencies (git, curl, tar) --check-php, -p Check PHP build dependencies and headers --check-ssl, -s Check SSL certificate dependencies --check-network, -n Check network and port availability --check-dns Check DNS resolution for .test domains --verbose, -v Show detailed diagnostic information --fix, -f Show fix suggestions for issues found --auto-fix Attempt to automatically fix issues where safe --quiet, -q Suppress non-error output Examples 🩺 What Doctor Checks System: git, curl, tar, gcc, make, pkg-config PHP Build: libzip, libjpeg, libpng, freetype, libxml2, libcurl, zlib SSL: OpenSSL, mkcert availability Network: Port availability, iptables for port forwarding DNS: dnsmasq installation, .test domain resolution {/* Page Footer Navigation */} Previous Architecture Next Documentation Home {/* Right TOC (Desktop Only) */} ); }

If you're experiencing problems not covered here, check the logs or ask for help in the community. Quick Help: Most issues can be resolved by restarting Chauffeur ( chauf restart ) or checking the logs ( chauf logs ). Installation Issues scrollToId(e, 'installation-issues')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Command Not Found: chauf command not found After installation, the chauf command isn't recognized. Solutions: If still not found: > ~/.bashrc source ~/.bashrc # For Zsh echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.chauffeur/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc source ~/.zshrc`} /> Permission Denied during installation Installer fails due to insufficient permissions. Network Issues during installation Cannot download Chauffeur binary. Service Issues scrollToId(e, 'service-issues')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Services Won't Start Chauffeur services fail to start when running chauf start . Diagnostic Steps: Common Solutions: Port Already in Use Another service is using the required ports. Project Not Accessible Linked project returns 404 or connection refused. PHP Issues scrollToId(e, 'php-issues')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># PHP Version Not Available Required PHP version isn't installed. PHP Errors in Application PHP application shows errors or blank pages. Slow PHP Performance PHP applications are loading slowly. SSL Issues scrollToId(e, 'ssl-issues')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Certificate Not Trusted Browser shows SSL security warning. Mixed Content Warnings HTTPS page loads HTTP resources. Network tab # Look for mixed content warnings # Common fixes: # 1. Update hardcoded URLs to HTTPS # 2. Use protocol-relative URLs: //example.com/resource.js # 3. Ensure all assets load over HTTPS # Test with curl curl -I https://my-app.test" /> Certificate Expired SSL certificate has expired. Domain Issues scrollToId(e, 'domain-issues')} className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-500 hover:text-primary cursor-pointer"># Domain Not Resolving *.test domains aren't resolving.
